title: Present perfect or past simple - Key differences and usage

options.answer: I went to London last year.
I have been to London last year.
I have went to London last year.

explanation.en: Past simple is used with specific past time expressions like 'last year'. Present perfect cannot be used with specific past time references.
explanation.ru: Past simple используется с конкретными выражениями прошедшего времени, такими как 'last year'. Present perfect нельзя использовать с конкретными ссылками на прошедшее время.
explanation.uz: Past simple 'last year' kabi aniq o'tgan zamon ifodalari bilan ishlatiladi. Present perfect aniq o'tgan zamon ma'lumotnomasi bilan ishlatilmaydi.

options.answer: She has lived here for five years.
She lived here for five years.
She has live here for five years.

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'for' shows a period that continues to the present. 'Has lived' is the correct present perfect form.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с 'for' показывает период, который продолжается до настоящего времени. 'Has lived' - правильная форма present perfect.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'for' bilan hozirgi vaqtgacha davom etuvchi davrni ko'rsatadi. 'Has lived' - to'g'ri present perfect shakli.

options.answer: Have you ever been to Paris?
Did you ever been to Paris?
Have you ever went to Paris?

explanation.en: Present perfect uses 'have/has + past participle' for life experiences. 'Been' is the past participle of 'be'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect использует 'have/has + причастие прошедшего времени' для жизненного опыта. 'Been' - причастие прошедшего времени от 'be'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect hayotiy tajriba uchun 'have/has + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi'ni ishlatadi. 'Been' - 'be' ning o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi.

options.answer: I have finished my homework yesterday.
I have finish my homework yesterday.

explanation.en: Past simple is used with specific past time expressions like 'yesterday'. Present perfect cannot be used with specific past time markers.
explanation.ru: Past simple используется с конкретными выражениями прошедшего времени, такими как 'yesterday'. Present perfect нельзя использовать с конкретными маркерами прошедшего времени.
explanation.uz: Past simple 'yesterday' kabi aniq o'tgan zamon ifodalari bilan ishlatiladi. Present perfect aniq o'tgan zamon belgilari bilan ishlatilmaydi.

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'since' shows an action starting in the past and continuing to now. 'They' takes 'have', not 'has'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с 'since' показывает действие, начавшееся в прошлом и продолжающееся до сих пор. 'They' требует 'have', а не 'has'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'since' bilan o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etuvchi harakatni ko'rsatadi. 'They' bilan 'have' ishlatiladi, 'has' emas.

explanation.en: Past simple is used for completed actions at a specific time in the past like 'in 2019'.
explanation.ru: Past simple используется для завершенных действий в конкретное время в прошлом, например 'in 2019'.
explanation.uz: Past simple 'in 2019' kabi o'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda tugallangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'just' shows a recently completed action with present relevance. 'Has arrived' is the correct form.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с 'just' показывает недавно завершенное действие с актуальностью для настоящего. 'Has arrived' - правильная форма.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'just' bilan hozirgi vaqt uchun ahamiyatli bo'lgan yaqinda tugallangan harakatni ko'rsatadi. 'Has arrived' - to'g'ri shakl.

options.answer: She has never been to Japan.
She never has been to Japan.
She has never went to Japan.

explanation.en: Present perfect uses 'never' before the past participle to show life experience. 'Been' is the correct past participle of 'be'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect использует 'never' перед причастием прошедшего времени для обозначения жизненного опыта. 'Been' - правильное причастие прошедшего времени от 'be'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect hayotiy tajribani ko'rsatish uchun o'tgan zamon sifatdoshidan oldin 'never'ni ishlatadi. 'Been' - 'be'ning to'g'ri o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi.

options.answer: I have seen that movie already.
I have saw that movie already.

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'already' shows completed action with present relevance. 'Seen' is the past participle of 'see'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с 'already' показывает завершенное действие с актуальностью для настоящего. 'Seen' - причастие прошедшего времени от 'see'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'already' bilan hozirgi vaqt uchun ahamiyatli bo'lgan tugallangan harakatni ko'rsatadi. 'Seen' - 'see'ning o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi.

options.answer: My brother called me this morning.
My brother has called me this morning.
My brother have called me this morning.

explanation.en: Past simple is used for completed actions at a specific time like 'this morning' when it's now afternoon/evening.
explanation.ru: Past simple используется для завершенных действий в конкретное время, например 'this morning', когда сейчас день/вечер.
explanation.uz: Past simple 'this morning' kabi aniq vaqtdagi tugallangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi, agar hozir tushdan keyin/kechqurun bo'lsa.
